releaseNotes: Added organization-scoped data isolation across admin and member workflows.
Added organization selection and quick organization creation during admin startup.
Blocked deleted member accounts from re-entering through saved sessions or Firebase Auth.
Displayed maintenance mode before members select an organization.
Applied maintenance state immediately for restricted members during startup.
Fixed mobile keyboard background glitches on the login and index pages without pausing the animated background.
Prevented the animated auth background from intercepting typing and touch input.
